title: Advanced Redstone Interface
description:
Compared to the basic Redstone Interface the advanced one can be linked to a total of 9 blocks. Instead of the Redstone Tool you use Position Filters which you insert into the gui of the block.

The gui has 9 slots and only accepts Position Filters. Each filter with a position set is one target; empty filters are ignored. Every target acts the same way as the target of a basic Redstone Interface: it receives the redstone input of the interface, side by side. If several interfaces point at the same block, the strongest signal counts. Breaking the block drops the inserted Position Filters.

Its targets are kept when the world is saved and reloaded.

properties.label: Linking
